name: 15057 · Mcdonald, PA
findings: ZIP 15057 (Mcdonald) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 25 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15057 (Mcdonald) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 15057 (Mcdonald) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
